description: Golden questions for evaluating the policy assistant. Expected facts are taken word-for-word in meaning from the documents in backend/knowledge. 'askAs' is the membership tier of the signed-in user, because retrieval is filtered by tier.

questions.question: Can I return an opened phone?
mustInclude: Only if the phone is defective or not as described
Within 7 days of delivery
Change of mind is not accepted once the seal is broken
Defect confirmed by a NovaMart technician or the brand's authorised service centre
mustNotSay: A 15-day window applies because the user is Gold

questions.question: How long do refunds take?
mustInclude: Inspection within 2 business days of receiving the product
UPI and wallets: 1 to 3 business days
Net banking: 3 to 5 business days
Cards: 5 to 7 business days
Store credit within 2 hours as an alternative

questions.question: Is express delivery free for Gold members?
mustInclude: Free for orders of ₹2,000 or more
Only in Delhi NCR, where express delivery is available
Below ₹2,000 express delivery costs ₹149
mustNotSay: Express delivery is free on all orders for Gold members
Express delivery is available everywhere in India

questions.question: What is the warranty period?
mustInclude: It depends on the product category
For example: mobile phones, laptops and TVs 1 year; small accessories 6 months; NovaTech products 2 years
Either lists periods by category or asks which product the customer means
mustNotSay: A single warranty period for every product

questions.question: Which payment methods are accepted?
mustInclude: UPI
Credit and debit cards: Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, American Express
Net banking
NovaMart gift cards and NovaPoints
Cash on delivery up to ₹50,000 where available

questions.question: Can I return a damaged product?
mustInclude: Yes
Report within 48 hours of delivery
Include photos of the product and packaging
Replacement, or a full refund if a replacement is not in stock
Free pickup

questions.question: Does delivery eligibility vary by location?
mustInclude: Yes, it depends on the delivery pincode
Express delivery only in Delhi NCR
Large appliances only in Delhi NCR and listed metro cities
Cash on delivery is not available for every pincode

questions.question: Are there different benefits for Gold members?
mustInclude: 3 NovaPoints per ₹100
Free standard delivery on all orders
Free express delivery on orders of ₹2,000 or more in Delhi NCR
15-day return window (not for opened electronics)
Priority customer support

questions.question: Can I pay with Bitcoin?
mustInclude: The approved documents do not mention Bitcoin or cryptocurrency
followUpRequired is true (offer a support ticket)
questions.acceptableAlternative: If the payment-methods chunk passes the threshold, an answer that says only that Bitcoin is not among the listed payment methods, with followUpRequired true, is also acceptable.

questions.question: Can I bring my pet dog into a NovaMart store?
mustInclude: The approved documents do not cover this
followUpRequired is true (offer a support ticket)
